name: example-requirement-verifier
purpose: Map a user requirement to observable verification evidence.

inputs.name: artifact
inputs.description: The artifact or running result to inspect.

outputs.name: evidence_report
outputs.description: Verified, partial, unverified, deferred, and blocked items.

procedure: Run the real artifact when available.
Record evidence for each material criterion.
constraints: Do not fabricate tests, tool results, or permissions.
Do not modify the artifact without explicit scope.
verification: Each must-have criterion has a cited observation or an explicit unverified status.
rollback: Remove the contract from the registry and revert dependent routing changes.

examples.situation: A must-have requirement has a live test result.
examples.response: Mark it verified and cite the observation.
examples.why: Completion is tied to external evidence.

examples.situation: The agent has only generated a plausible answer.
examples.why: Output is not proof of completion.

examples.situation: A screenshot appears polished but interaction behavior is unavailable.
examples.response: Score visible qualities and mark live behavior not assessable.
examples.why: A screenshot cannot establish keyboard, error, or recovery behavior.

examples.situation: The user explicitly requests a read-only review.
examples.response: Do not modify the artifact while reviewing it.
examples.why: The scope and permission are intentionally narrower.

examples.situation: A completion claim has no evidence reference.
examples.response: Convert it into a partial report with the missing evidence listed.
examples.why: Honest incompleteness is safer than false success.

limitations: Does not replace host-level permissions, sandboxing, or independent verification.
uncertainty: Screenshot-only quality judgments cannot establish live interaction behavior.
lessons_learned: Separate generated output from verified completion.
